title: Python Decision Output
description: Decision returned by the Python policy controller for a hook event (boundary contract §4.3). The decision vocabulary is exactly allow|deny|ask; the token 'block' is not a permitted value anywhere. 'continue' is a behavioral modifier permitted only on a 'deny' response (non-recoverable Stop/SubagentStop).

decision.description: Single canonical enforcement outcome. 'deny' is the only blocking term; 'block' is not part of the contract.

reason_id.description: Deterministic reason ID from a canonical family (CHK/INV/BG/POL) or boundary-only PC family.

continue.description: Behavioral modifier (NOT a decision value). When false on a 'deny' for Stop/SubagentStop, signals a non-recoverable failure: the session MUST NOT continue. Permitted only alongside decision='deny'.

allOf.$comment: 'continue' is permitted only when decision is 'deny'.
